cd /app && timeout 30 python3 -c "
import os, sys, smtplib, subprocess
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from time import sleep

DOMAIN_NAME = 'local.edu'

def send_email(*, body, subject, from_addr, to_addr):
    msg = MIMEText(body)
    msg['Subject'] = subject
    msg['From'] = from_addr
    msg['To'] = to_addr
    print(f'sending from {from_addr} to {to_addr}', flush=True)
    with smtplib.SMTP('localhost', 25) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)
    print('sent ok', flush=True)

user = os.urandom(8).hex()
print(f'user: {user}', flush=True)
subprocess.run(['useradd', user], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
print('user added', flush=True)
mbox_path = f'/var/mail/{user}'
send_email(from_addr=f'tester@{DOMAIN_NAME}', to_addr=f'{user}@{DOMAIN_NAME}', subject='Direct Message', body='Direct test message')
print('after send', flush=True)
sleep(3)
print(f'mbox exists: {os.path.exists(mbox_path)}', flush=True)
" 2>&1
